note: Two questions instead of twenty. A question moves on only once it is answered right, so after the five-second countdown the steps press its answers in turn until the quiz ends.

steps.evaluate: (async () => { for (let press = 0; press < 30; press++) { const options = [...document.querySelectorAll('li.h5p-joubelui-button')].filter((option) => option.getClientRects().length > 0); if (options.length === 0) return `${press} presses`; options[press % options.length].click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 900)) } return 'still asking after 30 presses' })()
